name: Beeswarm
summary: Every observation as a non-overlapping dot along a value axis, one row per group, with interquartile band and median tick — shows dispersion and where the target sits.
summary_zh: 把每个观测值画成互不重叠的点，按分组逐行排列，叠加四分位区间和中位数刻度，直观展示离散程度以及目标公司所处位置。
description_zh: 适合展示同业估值倍数（按行业）或交易溢价（按对价方式）等一维分布：每个点是一家公司 / 一笔交易，点沿数值轴排列、在组内自动错开不重叠，浅色带为 25–75 分位区间，深色短线为中位数，组名下方注明样本数与中位数。目标公司以 accent-2 高亮并直接标注名称，可选 extremes 模式标注组内最高 / 最低值。数据为长表：label（名称）+ value（数值）+ group（分组），可选 size 映射气泡大小、colorBy 按字段着色。比箱线图更诚实（小样本也能看清每个点），比柱状图更能体现分布。
best_for: Peer trading multiples by sector / region
Precedent transaction premia by consideration type
Showing where the target sits within a peer distribution
avoid_when: Thousands of observations (use a histogram or box plot)
A single number per group is all that matters (use a bar)
Groups have only one or two observations each

label.desc: Observation name (company, deal) — used for labels, tooltip and cross-filter

value.desc: Value plotted along the axis (multiple, premium, margin)

group.desc: Row / column grouping (sector, consideration); omit for a single swarm

size.desc: Optional bubble size (sqrt / area scale), e.g. market cap

target.desc: Flag field marking the target (accent-2 + label)

orientation.desc: horizontal (one row per group) | vertical (one column per group)

highlight.desc: Label value(s) drawn in accent-2 and labelled, in addition to rows flagged by encode.target

labels.desc: Direct labels: 'highlight' | 'extremes' (also min / max per group) | 'all' (collisions hidden) | 'none'

median.desc: Median tick per group and 'n · Med.' line under the group name

band.desc: Shaded band per group: 'iqr' (25th–75th percentile) | 'range' (min–max) | false

overall.desc: Dashed line at the median of all observations

refLines.desc: [{value, label, color}] reference lines, e.g. proposed offer premium — dashed in --rk-ref unless a colour is given

colorBy.desc: 'single' | 'group' | a field name (categorical colours + legend toggle)

sizeRange.desc: [min, max] diameter in px when encode.size is set (>= 7px keeps the smallest dot legible)

sizeLegend.desc: Size key (circles at nice values, top right) when encode.size is set

format.desc: Value format code; defaults to the value field's format

zoom.desc: dataZoom along the value axis (slider; Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch); the swarm re-flows on zoom

wheelZoom.desc: With zoom: true = zoom on the plain mouse wheel; null = plain wheel scrolls the report, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel zooms

legend.desc: Show the legend when colorBy is a field

interactions: Hover a dot: value, delta to group median, rank in group
Hover a row: n, quartiles, mean
Click a dot to cross-filter by label; click a row to cross-filter by group (generic field names such as target / type / category stay scoped to this dataset)
Dots fan out from the group median on entry
